title: Start the interview
caption: Hands-on 1a: let the AI question you about your quiz, and keep the chat open.

steps.first: Open the quiz Workflow and pick “Turn a source into a quiz”.
steps.second: Step “Name the categories”: copy the prompt, paste it into your AI chat with your article’s link or text.
steps.third: Step “Grill me”: copy the next prompt and answer the AI’s questions, one at a time.
steps.fourth: Leave the chat open: the next Episode comes before the interview ends.

done: The AI asks you its questions one by one, and you have answered the first few.

workflow.label: Open the quiz Workflow
workflow.pick: On the page, pick “Turn a source into a quiz”. Each step there has the prompt to copy, in a chat version and one for an agent.

help.label: Where you're stuck
help.placeholder: Paste what the AI answered, or describe where you're stuck…
help.copyTip: Paste this prompt into an AI you are allowed to use.
help.noError: (I haven't pasted anything yet: ask me what I see.)

chats.openAIChatTip: Open an empty {chat} chat in a new tab, then paste the prompt

help.step: Stage 1, Requirements: Name the categories, then Grill me

talking-points.description: Start the grill now and stop after about twenty minutes, mid-interview: the requirements Episode explains what the participants are doing, and they finish it right after. ChatGPT works; Gemini or Claude are better at the later HTML page.
